$comment: Translation status per locale and domain. A locale is served as its own language only when every critical domain is reviewed; otherwise pages serve the English original and say so. While `pendingKeysAllowed` is true (the build phase), a reviewed domain may still hold `null` keys that the maintainer will translate in one pass at the end of the build; the checker lists them. Set it to false at the end and the checker fails on any remaining null. Never mark a domain reviewed or machine_assisted without a named reviewer and date. The `problems` domain is non-critical and pending in ha, ig, and yo until the maintainer's full translation pass; it must be translated, reviewed, and marked critical before the first form ships.
